description: This file contains a PHP trait 'DecryptionTrait' that provides decryption functionalities for AWS SDK crypto operations. It includes methods for decrypting ciphertext streams, extracting tags, stripping ciphertext, and building decrypting streams based on cipher schemes.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts the provided ciphertext using specified provider, envelope, and options, returning a decryption stream.

methods.name: getTagFromCiphertextStream
methods.description: Extracts the authentication tag from the ciphertext stream.

methods.name: getStrippedCiphertextStream
methods.description: Returns a stream with the ciphertext data excluding the tag.

methods.name: getDecryptingStream
methods.description: Creates a decryption stream based on cipher options, wrapping the ciphertext stream appropriately.
